# Review Current Orchestration Definition

## What & Why
Independently reconcile formal definition acceptance for the current canonical Paired Task Orchestration SKILL.md, including the existing #120/#121 amendment obligation and later authorized source revisions. Prior definition findings and renewal hashes do not accept altered inputs.

Keep this definition-only track distinct from resource/full-plan verification and the original #102 retrospective Task B. This task does not declare itself a compliant replacement Task B, mutate #121 or extend the #102-specific cooperative exception to another primary.

## Done looks like
- A genuine independent review context reads locally delivered inputs, full #120/#121 plans, applicable authoring authority for later changes, immutable pre-edit sources and complete current canonical confirmation/Paired/Router contracts.
- Publish a new distinct definition-review report and evidence annex outside `.local/`, preserving all earlier reports. Bind current SKILL.md bytes, original scope, authorized revisions, real native records, independent context and limits.
- Check original #120 acceptance without weakening it: the complete limited exception; all six staging conditions and missing-proof stop; frontmatter, links and entry point below 500 lines; retained canonical sources, durable deliverables, one-pair/full-payload/approval/runtime boundaries; tracked amendment evidence and inert source guard; separate independent confirmation and real host demonstration claims.
- Reconcile later authorized outcomes/routine-method autonomy with the same original requirements and authority. Routine method freedom must not waive required evidence, fixed methods, protected-plan amendment, stage gates or independent post-repair acceptance.
- Resolve amendment-specific applicability against the authentic present companion rather than reviving the obsolete missing-companion finding. Verify the exact #120 finalized/committed barrier and a permitted existing-obligation reconciliation or expressly authorized current-byte acceptance route before granting formal acceptance.
- Distinguish structural/source adequacy, formal definition acceptance, resource acceptance and runtime proof. If authentic barrier, applicability, revision authority, delivery or independence evidence is unavailable, retain the precise blocked requirement and owner; do not manufacture a provider receipt or self-certify.
- Record acceptance only for its exact independently reviewed scope and bytes. Accepted D-01/D-02 rule repairs and narrowly accepted autonomy leaves retain existing scope, not new package acceptance.

## Out of scope
Resource/full-plan acceptance, #102 retrospective confirmation, canonical skill edits, native task creation/mutation, historical report replacement, tests/imports/checks/builds, runtime/store operations, settings changes, account access, source projection/publication, FG-02 drafting, approval, execution, hooks, merge or deployment.
